recommend: park (decision.json): the remaining path is the chain lemma + the synchronization identity + boundaries, then proof.md and a multi-stage formalization with no template; alternative: one ~2 h sync stage with a hard stop
mechanism: An exact defect-level model: 8 local rules on edges with equal cells (defects), driven by a head phase in Z/4; the 0^inf ends are 00-defect chains. Each trip turns at the rightmost bit-0 defect and returns with an alternating delta (z1 at delta 2 wiggles +2, o1 at delta 0 turns left). The left end and the left records come from the same rules; fossils are inert mod 4 by construction. On top sits a multi-level counter (observed, not derived): x3 blocks per epoch. Induction stage: away from the chain ends and one annihilation per epoch (X runs out), the machine is exactly a compressed TM on the defects (8 states, symbols mod 4); a 4-defect U block is a closed finite transducer (53 of 512 entries used) carrying one ternary digit, most significant on the left; the record macro additionally needs X/Y lengths in step with the counter (observed linear recurrences).
closed_gaps: Phase rule at the defect level: 8 local rules (4 per direction) plus 1 halting rule, exact on any tape; 1,000/1,000 + 20,000/20,000 random tapes (2-35% defect density, 0^inf ends, 4,386 reaching a halt) agree event-by-event with direct simulation
Model = machine on the blank run: 88,860/88,860 events to 1e9 and 388,516/388,516 events to 2e10 (turn cells + step indices) identical to work/turns2.c
Trip-level phase rule (L)+(R)+(L'): 93,231/93,232 trip segments to 2e10 (the miss is the start-up chain entry at step 1,070)
Left end needs no extra rules: it is the 0-chain under the same 8 rules; every left record is (L') and moves lo by 3
Fossils inert mod 4 is derived from the rule form; model check 10/10 identical (0 mod 4), 0/10 (2 mod 4), 200,000 events each from step 6e8
Epoch laws extended by the model to 1e14 (no halt): F 224496, 673560, 2020752, 6062328 (3F+72 on all 7 transitions); X 20408, 61232, 183704, 551120, 1653368 (3X+8 on all 8)
Level-3 counter as a record macro on mod-4 label words: 6 classes, one U digit per epoch; 23/23 records 11..33 to 6.2e13 (17 beyond the 6 defining ones)
Random instances: 120/120 (seed 20261012) + 320/320 (seed 7) perturbed record-to-record runs (+4j on random long fossil gaps) give the predicted next word; negative control +4j+2: 0/18
Trip counts per record interval: N(n+6)=9N(n)+c_r, 11/11 confirmations, 0 mismatches to 1.2e14; powers of 3 in classes r1/r4
Siblings: 512 (start B) 23/23 records = W(n); 588 (start F, mirrored) 23/23 records = W(n-1), model to 1.2e14

Compressed defect TM: with gaps forgotten the 8 rules are a TM on the defects (8 head states, symbols = position mod 4), exact unless a defect moves onto/next to another; 19,709/19,709 (gaps>=2, seed 20261012) + 19,990/19,990 (gaps>=4, seed 7) random blocks agree with dmodel (collisions flagged and excluded)

Collision census to 1e13 (24,832,839 events): the only interior collisions are 8 rightward d=0 annihilations, one per epoch where X runs out; no interior leftward-turn or wiggle collision (no halt pattern); other collisions only at the chain ends (32 left records, right chain)

U-digit transducer: exhaustive 512-entry table (4^4 residues x 2 entry sides), no loops, <= 13 events per traversal; blank run records 15-24: 387,538/387,538 U-block episodes match it, using 53 of 512 entries (the transducer closes)

Each U block cycles through 3 states x 2 phase frames (A 0z0 1z1 1z0 0o0 -> B 0z0 0o0 2z1 0o1 -> C 0z0 3z0 3z0 0o0, then bit-flipped); only its 2nd defect moves (+1, 0, -1, back by a +2 wiggle): one ternary digit per U, most significant on the left (754, 2,266, 6,802 changes per interval, c' = 3c+4)
Synchronization observed: X runs out at trip t of N in the interval after records of class r2/r5, t' = 3t+15 / 3t+25 and N' = 3N+12 / 3N+22, 6/6 transitions to 1e13
remaining_gaps: The macro is not uniform in u: inserting one extra U (valid word P U^(u+1) T_r) into records 11/17 breaks it 3/3, so the induction must run on the epoch index with exact X/Y lengths in step with the counter
Chain lemma: the ternary counter on U^k for every k from the 53-entry sub-table (two-way composition: carries go left, return passes wiggle and can turn the head back)
Synchronization identity: derive t, N in closed form from the transducer + right boundary (T classes, wall, Y, right chain) and show X is used up exactly at trip t, every epoch
(I2a)/(I2b) for all u (observed: no interior collision except the epoch annihilation) need the chain lemma; boundaries P + left chain and T + right chain not written as lemmas

model.defect: edge e between cells e, e+1 with equal cells; both 0^inf ends are chains of 00 defects
model.phase: phi in Z/4; leftward D1@phi D0@phi-1 E1@phi-2 C0@phi-3; rightward B0@phi C1@phi+1 A0@phi+2 B1@phi+3
model.rules: d=(e-phi) mod 4. Leftward: d0 pass phi+1; d3 pass phi-1; d1/d2 turn at cell e, D^={e-1,e}. Rightward: d0 turn at cell e+1, D^={e,e+1}; d1 wiggle D^={e,e+2} (net defect +2, phi+1, +2 steps); d2 pass phi-1; d3 pass phi+1. Turns keep phi.
model.halt: only rightward d=1 with e+1 in D (C> 111)
model.trip_rule: (L) turn at the rightmost bit-0 defect (bit 1 = d in {0,3} in the right-to-left scan); (R) return with delta 0/2 alternating per defect: z1 at delta 2 wiggles, o1 at delta 0 turns left; (L') no bit 0: enter the left chain, pass lo-1 (d=0), turn at lo-2, lo -= 3 (left record)
model.mod4: decisions use only positions mod 4 and defect order, so fossils are inert mod 4 (derived)
